---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for PanelMind
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of what problem you're trying to solve.

> Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you considered? Why is this approach better?

## Use case

Describe the user story:

- As a **[founder / contributor / user]**
- I want to **[do something]**
- So that **[outcome]**

## Mockups / examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features in other tools.

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I'd be willing to submit a PR for this
- [ ] I'd be willing to help review a PR for this
- [ ] I just want the feature, not to build it
